TMC Project Manager Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: TMC Project Manager Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Project Manager post at TMC?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Manager post at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/ BAMS/ BHMS/ BDS degree from a recognized institution along with a PG Diploma in Clinical Research and five years of experience in clinical research. A Master's Degree in Public Health (MPH) is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this TMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates can directly attend the interview on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Manager post at Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Tata Memorial Centre, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, Pincode: 410210.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates, as this information is not explicitly provided in the summary.
